message.content:
Now I can see the vulnerability clearly. In `vcardstructured_new_from_string`, the code writes to `st->field[st->num_fields++]` without checking against `VCARD_MAX_STRUCTURED_FIELDS` (20). If the input string has more than 20 semicolon-separated fields, it will write past the bounds of the `field` array, causing a buffer overflow. Then in `vcardstructured_free`, it iterates over `st->num_fields` entries and reads uninitialized memory.

Let me look at the vcardstructuredimpl.h to confirm the struct definition:
